dimensions.name: Governance Awareness
dimensions.rationale: All orchestration steps executed successfully with schema validation success on every span. The rule-context-loader step correctly loaded the rules context, and all prompt versions are consistent with the expected configuration. No governance violations or validation errors were detected, indicating full alignment with provided rules and schemas.

dimensions.name: Causal Reasoning Depth
dimensions.rationale: The causal chain from rules loading through conversation-to-aw, evolution map, alignment engine, and architecture intent generation was completed without interruption. All intermediate artifact generation succeeded, and the final intent generator produced valid output, demonstrating a coherent cause-effect reasoning flow from initial context to final architecture intent.

dimensions.name: Architectural Tension Analysis
dimensions.rationale: The alignment engine executed successfully, indicating that architectural tensions were surfaced and analyzed. The subsequent architecture intent generation also succeeded, which implies that trade-offs were resolved and documented in the final intent. The absence of schema errors and the completion of the full pipeline provide strong evidence of effective tension analysis and resolution.
